gaps: The available setup has only one awarded vendor, not three vendors with QA vendor 3 and two other allocations.
The vocabulary has no operation for the exact award-removal action or for restoring an award with 5 units.
The proposal read-back schema does not expose known assertion paths for allocation totals, vendor membership, or the ₹0 empty-award total.
